home.todayTitle: Who should you think about today?
home.emptyText: Add people to see what's ahead.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.subtitle: Never miss an occasion. Always know what to give.
auth.name: Your name
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

people.title: People
people.emptyText: Add the people who matter so you never miss their occasions.

person.name: Name
person.birthDateHelp: The year is optional — often you only know the day and month.
person.notesHelp: Kept private. Never sent to AI.
person.deleteText: Notes, interests and history are deleted too.

onboarding.explainTitle: Let's find occasions in your contacts
onboarding.explainBody: We read **only names** and, when present, **birthdays**. That's all.
onboarding.explainNo2: We don't read photos, emails or addresses
onboarding.deniedBody: That's fine. You can add people manually and the app works just the same.
onboarding.confirmBody: We worked these out from first names. Confirm the correct ones — we only send reminders for those.
onboarding.confirmQuestion: Does {{name}} celebrate their name day on {{date}}?
onboarding.foundNothing: No dates found in your contacts. You can add them manually — it takes a few seconds per person.

push.title: Should we remind you in advance?
push.body: We'll send a notification a few days before each occasion. You can change how many days at any time.
push.deniedBody: That's fine. Upcoming occasions still show on the home screen.

gift.title: What's your budget?
gift.subtitle: Looking for ideas for {{name}}
gift.emptyText: Try a wider budget, or add a few interests so we know what they like.

aiConsent.title: Want better ideas?
aiConsent.body: To find suitable ideas, we send our AI provider:
aiConsent.sends: approximate age, relationship, interests and budget
aiConsent.notSends: we do NOT send names, phone numbers or your notes
aiConsent.note: You can change this in settings at any time.

analyze.title: Tell me about {{name}}
analyze.hint: Write freely, in your own words. The more you tell us, the better the ideas.
analyze.placeholder: For example: works in IT, loves cars and recently started going to the gym.
analyze.found: Here's what we understood. Tick what's right:
analyze.nothing: We couldn't work anything out. You can pick interests manually.

profile.title: My profile
profile.linkHint: Send it to friends so they can tell you their birthday.
profile.statsNone: No one has filled it in yet
profile.wishlistHint: So friends know what to get you.
profile.shareMessage: Hi! Add your birthday here so I don't forget:

account.title: Account
account.languageHint: Notifications and emails will arrive in this language too.
account.export: Download a copy of your data
account.exportHint: A file with everything we hold about you: your people, occasions, gift history, and where each piece of information came from.
account.exportUnavailable: File sharing isn't available on this device.
account.deleteHint: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it.

accountDelete.title: Delete account
accountDelete.body: Deletion is permanent. We don't keep a copy, so nothing can be recovered.
accountDelete.whatPeople: Your people, with their notes, interests and occasions
accountDelete.whatLink: Your public link and everything friends filled in through it
accountDelete.whatSettings: Your settings, reminders and connected devices
accountDelete.exportBody: After deletion, there's nothing left to download.
accountDelete.doneBody: All your data has been erased. Thank you for using Wishio.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.profileHint: When and how we remind you
notifications.deniedTitle: Notifications are off on your phone
notifications.deniedBody: You can turn them on in your phone's settings. Until then, occasions show up on the home screen and in the weekly summary.
notifications.askBody: To remind you before each occasion, your phone needs to allow it.
notifications.unregisteredBody: Notifications are allowed, but this phone couldn't be registered. Check your connection and try again.
notifications.pushOff: You won't get notifications. Occasions stay on the home screen.
notifications.whenFooter: Pick up to {{max}}. We always remind you on the day itself.
notifications.hourFooter: By your phone's clock. Quiet hours can't be picked.
notifications.quietFooter: We send nothing during this time.
notifications.digestFooter: Monday mornings, the week's occasions at {{email}}.

submissions.title: Who is {{name}}?
submissions.body: The name looks like someone on your list. Choose who it is, so the details reach the right person.
submissions.keepsName: {{name}} gets the birthday and interests from this submission. The name stays as it is on your list.
submissions.gone: This submission is no longer waiting for an answer.

gifts.ideasEmpty: No saved ideas yet. Save one from recommendations or write your own.
gifts.givenHint: It moves to the history, and recommendations won't suggest it again.
gifts.historyEmpty: Gifts you've given show up here, by year.
gifts.deleteHistoryText: “{{title}}” will no longer count for recommendations.
gifts.savedEmpty: No saved ideas. Tap “Save” on a recommendation.
gifts.boughtBody: We'll keep it in your gift ideas, so you remember what you chose.
